info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List Nodes API

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: Cluster ID from which the nodes will be listed from.

params.name: pool_id
params.description: Pool ID on which to filter the returned nodes.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order of the returned nodes.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for the returned nodes.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of nodes per page.

params.name: name
params.description: Name to filter on, only nodes containing this substring in their name will be returned.

params.name: status
params.description: Status to filter on, only nodes with this status will be returned.

items.docs: List all the existing nodes for a specific Kubernetes cluster.

info.name: Delete a Node in a Cluster

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: node_id
params.description: ID of the node to replace.

params.name: skip_drain
params.description: Skip draining node from its workload (Note: this parameter is currently inactive).

items.docs: Delete a specific Node. The node will first be drained and pods will be rescheduled onto another node. Note that when there is not enough space to reschedule all the pods (such as in a one-node cluster, or with specific constraints), disruption of your applications may occur.
